'''''Onece 5''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] that was part of [[Onece group]]. Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was shipping foodstuffs through the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], and went through customs at [[Outpost D-34]]. The freighter was inspected by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and after confirming its cargo to be legal it was allowed to leave. However, ''[[Onece 3]]'' was actually smuggling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and was [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34|disabled]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and was captured, despite Rebel intervention. ''Onece 5'', meanwhile, entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] bound for parts unknown.
